mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Seraphine has a @MulticastChance@% chance to multicast a projectile
Seraphine sends out a wave of sound, damaging and slowing enemies hit.

Seraphine sings the perfect note, halting all enemies in their tracks and protecting allies with invulnerability for @InvulnDuration@s. At its crescendo, a ring of force is let loose, dealing <scaleAP>@RBaseDamage@ damage</scaleAP> and pushing back all enemies it collides with.
Seraphine grants a <shield>@TotalShieldStrength@ shield</shield> and <speed>Move Speed</speed> to herself and allies around herself for 5 seconds.
